scope: restricted single-level positive DIVDRA runtime materialization only

invariants.name: one_calculation_kernel
invariants.basis: Binding reuses the one admitted DIVDRA process and current generic runtime/solver contracts; no use-case-specific kernel is introduced.

invariants.name: kernel_separate_from_io
invariants.basis: Binding has no file, parser, format, unit or path dependency.

invariants.name: explicit_data_separation
invariants.basis: Immutable distribution parameters, dynamic hydraulic view, scalar transfer, forcing projection and diagnostics remain distinct typed objects.

invariants.name: compact_persistent_state
invariants.basis: Binding adds zero persistent per-column state.

invariants.name: scratch_per_worker
invariants.basis: Node transfer and process diagnostics used during materialization are local call scratch.

invariants.name: scalable_memory_layout
invariants.basis: Public target is a plain allocatable level-by-node array and does not force object-per-column solver storage.

invariants.name: transactional_timesteps
invariants.basis: Target forcing is published only after process success; rejected evaluation cannot mutate the unallocated target.

invariants.name: cheap_recompute_and_warm_start
invariants.basis: Binding is stateless and repeatable from supplied inputs; no hidden history constrains recomputation.

invariants.name: generic_time
invariants.basis: Binding has no time unit, day, month, year or calendar assumption.

invariants.name: flexible_coupling_windows
invariants.basis: No coupling-window semantics are introduced or constrained.

invariants.name: coupling_core_functionality
invariants.basis: This workunit only materializes a process sink; transaction/coupling orchestration remains owned by existing runtime/kernel contracts.

invariants.name: explicit_groundwater_interface_contract
invariants.basis: No MODFLOW interface or head/flux matching policy is implemented here.

invariants.name: mass_conservation_absolute
invariants.basis: Binding copies the qualified node projection unchanged; scalar transfer remains authoritative and no renormalization or mass tolerance is added.

invariants.name: interface_sensitivities_first_class
invariants.basis: No coupling response tangent is added, removed or blocked; drainage derivative work remains separately held.

invariants.name: limit_coupling_cost
invariants.basis: Binding adds one process projection call and no extra full SWAP run.

invariants.name: multiswap_primary
invariants.basis: Binding is stateless, allocation-local and independent of global state, suitable for per-job/batched runtime use.

invariants.name: no_mandatory_one_to_one_modflow
invariants.basis: No MODFLOW cell or tile identity is referenced.

invariants.name: deep_vadose_optional_external
invariants.basis: No deep-vadose transfer semantics are introduced.

invariants.name: mass_conservative_component_transition
invariants.basis: No component-mode transition is performed.

invariants.name: alternative_soil_water_solvers_open
invariants.basis: Binding consumes the generic process_hydraulic_view_t and does not depend on Richards internals or a specific solver implementation.

invariants.name: reuse_swap_physics
invariants.basis: Exact qualified DIVDRA physics is reused rather than duplicated in runtime.

invariants.name: no_headcalc_internal_coupling
invariants.basis: Only process_hydraulic_view_t is accepted; HeadCalc arrays/internals are absent.

invariants.name: physics_vs_solver_policy_separate
invariants.basis: No numerical policy changes physical drainage options; the frozen restricted process scope is explicit.

invariants.name: predictable_runtime
invariants.basis: Binding performs one bounded spatial-distribution evaluation and one row publication; it introduces no retry loop.

invariants.name: reference_mode_available
invariants.basis: Reference solver/runtime modes are not changed.

invariants.name: runtime_diagnostics
invariants.basis: Typed binding diagnostics expose runtime status, process status, publication state, shape and authoritative scalar plus the qualified process diagnostics.

invariants.name: optional_functionality_scales_with_use
invariants.basis: Drainage row allocation occurs only when the binding is explicitly invoked and succeeds.

invariants.name: runtime_coupler_owns_composition
invariants.basis: The new code is explicitly a runtime materialization layer between process output and runtime forcing; process remains unaware of system composition.

invariants.name: no_silent_dependencies
invariants.basis: No midnight, daily, legacy-file or MODFLOW assumption exists; hydraulic-view provenance and scalar exchange are explicit inputs.

invariants.name: audit_every_architecture_change
invariants.basis: All 30 invariants are dispositioned in this persisted audit and enforced where machine-checkable by the F-MR33 gate.
